description: The levels a congressional budget resolution sets for a fiscal year and the years after it: federal revenues, new budget authority, outlays, deficit and debt, plus new budget authority and outlays for each budget function (National Defense, Health, Medicare, Social Security, Net Interest, ...). Returns the adopted resolution; if none was adopted, the most advanced proposal that passed a chamber (clearly marked adopted:false), or found:false with a named reason. Includes a sum check: the function figures added up beside the resolution's stated totals. Use for "FY2025 budget resolution defense outlays", "what did the House budget plan for FY2027 assume for revenues?". Dollars are nominal US dollars. Optional filters narrow function and year. Source: U.S. Congress, as published by the U.S. Government Publishing Office.

adopted_only.description: true: return only a resolution adopted by both chambers; otherwise a one-chamber-passed plan may be returned if none was adopted (marked adopted:false).

fiscal_year.description: The budget year the resolution is for, e.g. 2025. Its levels also cover the later years in the resolution (typically nine more).

function.description: Budget function, case-insensitive substring ("Defense", "Medicare", "Net Interest") or the three-digit code ("050"). Omit for all functions.

package_id.description: Read a specific version, e.g. "BILLS-119hconres113pcs" (ids come from budget_resolution_find).

target_year.description: Limit the output to one fiscal year inside the resolution (e.g. 2027 within a resolution that runs 2027-2036). Omit for every year.

name: budget_resolution_targets
